title: panicum orthum
intro: Panicum orthum, commonly known as false button grass, is a plant species native to tropical regions. This plant has been used for its medicinal properties, which include the ability to reduce inflammation, improve digestion, and support immune function due to its various health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Panicum orthum include its analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antipyretic properties, making it a potential treatment for fever, pain, and infections. The bioactive constituents of Panicum orthum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
